name: savvy-progress
description: Progress bar above the prompt for /savvy-flow, plus an agents panel (/agents-info): running, finished and planned subagents with model, task progress, context, cost and time. Crab office edition, a fork of johnnyvizz's savvy-progress: a costume and a name per role, and a pixel office where the agents work, with a day and night cycle.

language.title: Panel language
language.description: auto follows Claude Code's language setting, then the system locale; en, ru or he (Hebrew, drawn right to left)

autoOpen.title: Open the agents panel
autoOpen.description: savvy: when a savvy-flow worker starts or a plan is reported; any: also when any other subagent starts

leadName.title: Lead crab's name
leadName.description: The name of the main session's crab, at the top of the list and at the office's front desk
